package.name: aav_teleop
package.description: Human drivers. Joystick: joy + teleop_twist_joy publish /drivers/joy/cmd_vel (TwistStamped) into twist_mux, and joy_teleop maps one button to /safety/estop. Keyboard: teleop_twist_keyboard (run by hand, stamped:=true) publishes /drivers/keyboard/cmd_vel. Replaces the 2025-26 joy_teleop_ackerman, which drove the wheels directly.
